mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passenger (id, user_id, passenger_name, id_card, passenger_type) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{passengerName}, #{idCard}, #{passengerType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, passenger_name, id_card, passenger_type, create_time, update_time FROM passenger WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, passenger_name, id_card, passenger_type, create_time, update_time FROM passenger WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id_card = #{idCard} LIMIT 1
